title: chrysanthemum vulgare
intro: Chrysanthemum vulgare, commonly known as the common chrysanthemum or rough chrysanthemum, is a perennial plant native to East Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum vulgare include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
